mapper.select: SELECT event_id, config_version, open_token, verified_at, ingest_paused FROM coupon_mq_control WHERE event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_mq_control(event_id, config_version, ingest_paused) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{configVersion}, TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_mq_control SET open_token = #{token}, verified_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), ingest_paused = FALSE WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND open_token IS NULL AND verified_at IS NULL
UPDATE coupon_mq_control SET ingest_paused = TRUE WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
